node: Retail shrink prevention, RFID, inventory accuracy, fraud detection, and store security infrastructure
summary: Expanded the node around scarce retail shrink and inventory-accuracy infrastructure. The most relevant US-listed candidates are not retailers themselves but RFID chip/platform vendors, item-level label/inlay suppliers, POS/self-checkout software vendors, and niche digital-watermark/fraud-prevention providers. Reference context includes large incumbents such as Johnson Controls' Sensormatic and Avery Dennison; the underfollowed lane is stronger in Impinj, NCR Voyix, and speculative micro-cap Digimarc. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
